item.title: North Korean delegations for disability rights, disaster response visit China | NK News

item.description: A federal court sentenced three Americans to prison or fines, including an Army soldier, for their roles in a scheme that helped North Korean information technology (IT) workers obtain remote jobs at U.S. companies using false identities. item.title: Kim Yo Jong says North Korea has ‘no reason’ to hold summit with Japan | NK News
item.description: The North Korean leader’s sister Kim Yo Jong slammed Japan for seeking a summit with Pyongyang on Monday, reiterating her previous rejection of diplomacy with Tokyo. item.title: North Koreans who lived near nuke test site show signs of radiation exposure | NK News
item.description: Nearly three dozen North Korean defectors who lived near the country’s nuclear test site have shown signs of chromosomal abnormalities, although researchers have not established a direct link to the tests, according to Seoul. item.title: Canada to deploy patrol aircraft to monitor North Korea sanctions evasion at sea | NK News
item.description: Canada will deploy a patrol aircraft to Japan this month to monitor North Korea’s illicit maritime activities in violation of U.N. sanctions, Tokyo’s Defense Ministry announced Monday.
